card.name: Dose frequency words in directions
card.fires_on: The word "daily" after "once", and "dose" or "doses" after words like "each", "next" or "subsequent", in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Once daily
modes.description: "daily" right after "once" in a statement of how often to take a drug.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of EVOTAZ is one tablet taken once<< daily>> orally with food [see Clinical Pharmacology

modes.label: Dose after a qualifier
modes.description: "dose" or "doses" after each, next or subsequent in dosing directions.
modes.example: instruct the patient to take the next<< dose>> at its scheduled time.

card.plain: It marks the word that finishes a phrase about how often a dose is taken, such as once daily or the next dose.
